svg.title: Who can touch what
svg.desc: Matrix of nine Atlas principals against the world, control and private databases and the find, insert, update and remove verbs, with the number of collections each may act on. The cleanup worker has no access to the private database; only the grader and the fixture builder read it.
svg.text: Collections each least-privilege principal may act on, per database and verb. A blank cell is a refusal.
the worker can’t read the grader’s answers (refused live on Atlas, code 13)
Source: packages/mongo/src/roles.ts. Numbers are collection counts; observer and projection_reader also hold a change-stream grant on control.
